title: Hot chocolate / cocoa, dry mix, made with whole or reduced‑fat (2 %) milk

content.title: About
content.content: The dry mix for hot chocolate contains cocoa powder, sugar and emulsifiers that allow a quick preparation simply by adding milk (whole or 2 % fat). The blend delivers a rich chocolate flavor and aroma, suitable for home use as well as for cafés and restaurants.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The mix usually includes a pinch of salt, which enhances sweetness and chocolate aroma.
Cocoa powder may be natural or alkalized (Dutch‑process), giving a darker color and smoother taste.
One serving (≈30 g) prepares in 1–2 minutes, saving time and resources.
Some versions add vanilla extract or spices such as cinnamon or nutmeg for flavor variation.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Cocoa is high in flavonoids, which help combat free radicals and support cardiovascular health.

items.title: Source of magnesium
items.content: Magnesium in cocoa contributes to muscle and nerve function and helps maintain normal blood pressure.

items.title: Mood‑boosting
items.content: Cocoa stimulates the production of serotonin and endorphins, which can improve mood and reduce stress.

items.title: Contains iron
items.content: Iron supports hemoglobin formation and oxygen transport in the body.

items.title: Lower fat when prepared with 2 % milk
items.content: Using reduced‑fat milk keeps the drink flavorful while reducing saturated fat intake.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: The mix often contains added sugar, so people with diabetes or those monitoring sugar intake should watch portion size.

items.title: Caffeine and theobromine
items.content: Cocoa contains modest amounts of caffeine and theobromine, which may affect sleep if consumed in large quantities.

items.title: Milk allergy or lactose intolerance
items.content: When prepared with whole milk, the drink is unsuitable for individuals allergic to milk proteins or intolerant to lactose.

items.title: Oxalate content
items.content: Cocoa is high in oxalates, which can contribute to kidney stone formation in susceptible individuals.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: Heat 200 ml of milk (whole or 2 % fat) in a saucepan until hot but not boiling. Add 30 g of the dry mix and whisk vigorously until fully dissolved. Optionally top with whipped cream, marshmallows or a pinch of salt.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the dry mix in a sealed container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Properly stored, it remains good for 12–18 months. Keep away from moisture.
